India bloc alleges BJP workers deleting voters' names in Jharkhand

The INDIA bloc has alleged that Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) workers are pressuring Booth Level Officers (BLOs) in Jharkhand to delete voters' names from electoral rolls. This accusation was reported by multiple news outlets covering the event. The specific details of the alleged pressure tactics or the number of voters affected were not detailed in the provided coverage.
